plugin.note: Fast Dagannoth tasks use cannon + melee at the Lighthouse or Jormungand's Prison. Catacombs offer prayer AFK and Dinh's bulwark aggression refreshes. Dagannoth Kings are the profitable alternative when prepared.

requirements: Horror from the Deep to be assigned and access the Lighthouse basement
The Fremennik Exiles for Jormungand's Prison
Waterbirth Island preparation for Waterbirth tasks or Dagannoth Kings
Optional Expert Reanimation access through the Arceuus spellbook and ensouled dagannoth heads
mechanics: Standard Dagannoth are weak for their combat level and have a 35% elemental weakness to earth spells.
The Lighthouse basement, Jormungand's Prison, and Waterbirth Island Dungeon are multicombat and allow cannon use.
Catacombs of Kourend Dagannoth cannot be cannoned, but can be killed with prayer AFK or difficult safespots.
Dagannoth at Jormungand's Prison and the Catacombs only use melee attacks.
Waterbirth Island Dagannoth are stronger than other task variants and include level 88 ranged and level 90 melee forms.
Dagannoth spawn can hatch from eggs while nearby Dagannoth remain aggressive.
Dagannoth Kings count on a normal Dagannoth assignment and are often killed for profit with Slayer helmet bonuses.
Ensouled dagannoth heads can be used for Expert Reanimation, trading Slayer speed for Prayer experience.

methods.label: Lighthouse cannon AFK
methods.summary: Use melee with a dwarf cannon in the Lighthouse basement for fast, low-effort Slayer experience.
recommendedFor: Players wanting AFK time without relying heavily on prayer
steps: Enter the Lighthouse basement after Horror from the Deep.
Set up the dwarf cannon in the multicombat Dagannoth area.
Fight with melee and let the cannon accelerate kills.
Use protection prayers, Bones to Peaches, Guthan's, or Saradomin godsword special attacks to extend trips.
If needed, sell noted food to Jossik and buy it back unnoted for a small cost.
risks: The Lighthouse is often busy with other cannon users.
Some Lighthouse level 74 Dagannoth attack with Ranged.
notes: The task page calls this one of the fastest Slayer experience options for Dagannoth.

methods.label: Jormungand's Prison cannon
methods.summary: Use a dwarf cannon and Protect from Melee against melee-only Dagannoth after The Fremennik Exiles.
recommendedFor: Cannon users with The Fremennik Exiles complete
Players who want simple prayer use
steps: Enter Jormungand's Prison after The Fremennik Exiles.
Set up the cannon in the Dagannoth section.
Use Protect from Melee because Dagannoth here only attack with melee.
Keep the cannon loaded and finish the task with melee.
notes: The task page describes Jormungand's Prison as a common cannoning location.

methods.label: Catacombs prayer AFK
methods.summary: Use prayer-boosting melee gear, Auto Retaliate, and periodic prayer restoration in the Catacombs.
recommendedFor: Players not using a dwarf cannon
steps: Stand in the southern Dagannoth section of the Catacombs.
Turn Auto Retaliate on and use melee with protection prayer.
Restore prayer points as needed.
When Dagannoth become tolerant, walk away and return or use Dinh's bulwark special attack with Lightbearer to maintain aggression.
risks: No dwarf cannon can be used in the Catacombs.
Aggression eventually expires unless reset or refreshed.
notes: Catacombs kills also give access to Catacombs tertiary drops where applicable.

methods.label: Catacombs safespot
methods.summary: Use the difficult Catacombs safespots when avoiding melee damage is more important than speed.
recommendedFor: Players who need to avoid direct melee damage
steps: Use safespot 1 by luring Dagannoth around the corner so they cannot path to you.
If using melee, use the same area to limit how many Dagannoth can attack at once.
Use safespot 2 by positioning a non-aggressive Warped Jelly between you and the Dagannoth.
Keep Dagannoth aggressive when using the Warped Jelly safespot so they line up cleanly.
risks: The task page describes these safespots as difficult to use.
Incorrect lures allow Dagannoth to path back to the player.

methods.label: Waterbirth Island task
methods.summary: Use the main first-floor multicombat area if assigned to Waterbirth Island; other areas have too few Dagannoth for normal tasking.
recommendedFor: Players already travelling toward Dagannoth Kings
steps: Use the main first-floor area because other Waterbirth areas have too few Dagannoth despite being multicombat.
Expect stronger level 88 ranged and level 90 melee Dagannoth than in the Lighthouse, Catacombs, or Jormungand's Prison.
While Dagannoth are still aggressive, walk near eggs every few minutes to hatch dagannoth spawn and speed up the task.
After aggression expires, use the skeleton safespot north-east of the dungeon entrance if needed.
risks: Waterbirth Dagannoth are stronger and hit harder than the other task variants.
The entrance is not multicombat; deeper travel requires Waterbirth-specific route preparation.

methods.label: Dagannoth Kings alternative
methods.summary: Kill Dagannoth Kings instead of regular Dagannoth for a harder but more rewarding task.
recommendedFor: Konar tasks assigned to Waterbirth Island Dungeon
requiredOrKeyItems: Dagannoth Kings tribrid or single-king gear
steps: Use the Dagannoth Kings when on a normal Dagannoth task or a Konar Waterbirth Island assignment.
Use Slayer helmet or black mask bonuses for faster kills.
Prefer Elite Fremennik Diary so Dagannoth bones are noted, because the bones are a major part of profit.
Use the Waterbirth shortcuts when possible; the 85 Agility shortcut bypasses the pet rock and rune thrownaxe route.
risks: The task page does not recommend killing the Kings without Elite Fremennik Diary because unnoted bones reduce profit and trip length.
The Kings require separate boss-trip preparation.

methods.label: Expert Reanimation
methods.summary: Use ensouled dagannoth heads for Prayer training during a task, accepting slower combat and Slayer experience.
recommendedFor: Non-Konar tasks where reanimation location flexibility matters
steps: Pick up ensouled dagannoth heads during the task.
Cast Expert Reanimation near the Dark Altar or where the Dagannoth died.
Kill the Reanimated Dagannoth for 35 Slayer XP and 936 Prayer experience.
risks: Combat and Slayer experience rates suffer compared with killing regular Dagannoth.
If the head is not reanimated soon enough, or is traded or teleported away from, it must be reanimated at the Dark Altar.

styleOptions.label: Melee cannon
styleOptions.summary: Fast task setup for Lighthouse, Jormungand's Prison, and Waterbirth Island.

styleOptions.label: Melee prayer AFK
styleOptions.summary: Prayer-boosting melee setup for Catacombs with optional Dinh's bulwark aggression refresh.

styleOptions.label: Ranged or Magic safespot
styleOptions.summary: Use ranged or magic from the Catacombs safespots when damage avoidance matters more than speed.

styleOptions.label: Dagannoth Kings
styleOptions.summary: Switch to the Dagannoth Kings strategy page when using the task for boss profit.

body:
# Dagannoth

Task-page strategy covering Lighthouse cannon melee, Jormungand's Prison cannon melee, Catacombs prayer AFK and safespots, Waterbirth Island tasking, Dagannoth Kings as the profitable alternative, Expert Reanimation, and seed box notes.
